image.title: Lea Fischer
image.alternative: A woman in her thirties with light-brown hair tied back and a navy blouse.

bio: Lea designed the ten house presets, from Aurora to Citrus, that come with the five shadcn presets. She defined Desiderio’s colour token scale, so dark mode, density and radius work in every theme. She also led the theme presets per page in 2.6, which give each styleguide chapter its own look. She checks every new component for token-only styling before it is merged.
